topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes, learning outcomes, and historical context.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming viruses led to the discovery of cellular oncogenes and how transformation is tested experimentally.

topics.label: Oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications and mechanistic actions of oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations using key cell cycle regulators.

topics.label: Mechanisms and forms of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how specific failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential mutation accumulation and inherited gene defects influence cancer development and malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session with book recommendations and an outline of the next lecture.
